highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 pairs Skia m158 rendering updates with HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and expanded script constants.
highlights_body: GPU corrections cover hairlines, text atlases, clip recording and displacement sampling. The collected changes also strengthen per-process hash seeding without changing hash-code stability within a process.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158 and incorporates subsequent same-milestone native fixes without changing SkiaSharp's public managed signatures.

Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 HarfBuzzSharp Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing constants, struct-based parsing and numeric conversions are preserved.

bullets.lead: Correct GPU sampling and clip limits
bullets.detail: Fixes reflected zero-length hairline caps and text-atlas selection. Displacement offsets now match float-precision filter bounds. Graphite accounts for pending clips and logs and skips draws whose clip stacks cannot fit a fresh pass.

Adds a 1 ms device-loss teardown delay for ARM proprietary drivers >=42 and <56. Native synchronous submission now reports fence-wait failures internally; GRContext.Submit remains void, with no new managed failure result and no change to asynchronous submission.

The shared HashCode implementation uses the OS cryptographic random generator for its per-process seed. Hashes remain randomized between processes and stable within one process; first use now also loads cryptography support.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Replaced the shared HashCode seed with OS-generated randomness and added analyzer safeguards for shipped code.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5: Preview 2 updates HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants. It also corrects reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip limits, with targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup timing.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Preview 1 introduces Skia m158 without changing managed APIs. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while the native HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script values, parsing and numeric conversions remain intact; no public managed member is removed.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: The managed API surface is unchanged. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine stays at 14.4.0.

v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.headline: Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes.
v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.body: HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script constants. Rendering corrections cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM drivers.
